title: Quantum-aware Transformer model for state classification
abstract: arXiv:2502.21055v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Entanglement is a fundamental feature of quantum mechanics, playing a crucial role in quantum information processing. However, classifying entangled states, particularly in the mixed-state regime, remains a challenging problem, especially as system dimensions increase. In this work, we focus on bipartite quantum states and present a data-driven approach to entanglement classification using transformer-based neural networks. Our dataset consists of a diverse set of bipartite states, including pure separable states, Werner entangled states, general entangled states, and maximally entangled states. We pretrain the transformer in an unsupervised fashion by masking elements of vectorized Hermitian matrix representations of quantum states, allowing the model to learn structural properties of quantum density matrices. translated_title: 面向量子态分类的量子感知Transformer模型
translated_abstract: 纠缠是量子力学的基本特征，在量子信息处理中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，对纠缠态进行分类，尤其是在混合态情形下，仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，特别是随着系统维数的增加。在这项工作中，我们聚焦于两体量子态，提出了一种基于Transformer神经网络的数据驱动的纠缠分类方法。我们的数据集由多样化的两体态构成，包括纯可分离态、Werner纠缠态、一般纠缠态以及最大纠缠态。我们通过掩蔽量子态向量化厄米矩阵表示中的元素，以无监督方式对Transformer进行预训练，使模型能够学习量子密度矩阵的结构特性。这一方法使模型能够将纠缠特性泛化到不同类别的量子态上。在训练完成后……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种量子感知的Transformer模型，通过对量子态厄米矩阵表示进行掩码式无监督预训练来学习量子密度矩阵的结构特性，从而实现两体量子态（涵盖可分离态、Werner态、一般纠缠态和最大纠缠态）的数据驱动纠缠分类。
en_tdlr: A quantum-aware Transformer model is proposed that learns structural properties of quantum density matrices through masked unsupervised pretraining on Hermitian matrix representations, enabling data-driven entanglement classification of bipartite quantum states.
